items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: There was a waiter at the Club, David Obie, who was quite a fan of mine

ctx.x: I don't know. Well, I'll tell you what. There was a waiter at the Club, David Obie, who was quite a fan of mine and he had been bringing in a lot of the performers around, that were working in Pittsburgh, and the musicians to come up there to hear me. So I'm thinking that Obie might have had some influence there, you know, in deciding who they should keep and who they should let go.
Well since that tip money didn't get back to the management anyway . . .
